title: By Bike or by Bus?
tip: lassen + infinitive: someone else does it for you. „Ich lasse mein Rad reparieren.“ The infinitive goes to the end, without zu. ich lasse; du lässt; er / sie lässt; wir lassen.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I'm having my bike repaired.'?

options.text: Ich lasse mein Rad zu reparieren.

exercises.prompt: I go to work by bike.
answers: Ich fahre mit dem Rad zur Arbeit.
Ich fahre zur Arbeit mit dem Rad.
Mit dem Rad fahre ich zur Arbeit.
Zur Arbeit fahre ich mit dem Rad.
Es gibt viel Verkehr.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'We're stuck in a traffic jam.'?

answers: The air is bad here because there is a lot of traffic.

Here the air is bad because there is a lot of traffic.
The air is bad because there is a lot of traffic here.
Because there is a lot of traffic, the air is bad here.
Because there is a lot of traffic, the air here is bad.
Because there is a lot of traffic here, the air is bad.
Der Lärm stört mich.
